question: Did any Binance BTC/USDT 1-minute candle reach a High of $110,000 or more after the market opened on May 9, 2025 and by May 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET?
rules: YES if the High of any one-minute candle on Binance's BTC/USDT market equals or exceeds 110,000.00 USDT between the market's creation (9 May 2025, 07:08 UTC) and 31 May 2025 at 11:59 PM ET; otherwise NO. Only Binance BTC/USDT counts. Source binance lists the 22 daily candles (interval 1d, UTC days) from 10 May through 31 May 2025, all inside that window. Each row is [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, ...]; the third element (high) is the highest one-minute High of that day. YES if any daily high is 110000 or more. If none is, answer NO; the slivers of the window outside these days (9 May after 07:08 UTC and 1 June before 04:00 UTC) are not covered by this replay.
